mission: ULVO Stage 3.0.1 - Physical Disk Recovery & Lifecycle Hardening

discrepancy_analysis_18gb.root_cause_1: NTFS Hardlink Inode Sharing: Deleting project environments decremented file link counts from 2 to 1 without freeing physical clusters because uv-cache/archive-v0 retained identical links.
discrepancy_analysis_18gb.root_cause_2: Dead Wheel Archives in uv-cache: PyTorch archives (torch-2.5.1+cu121: 4.24 GB, torch-2.14.0+cu130: 2.81 GB, torch-2.14.0 cpu: 0.44 GB) remained unreferenced in archive-v0 with nlink=1.
discrepancy_analysis_18gb.root_cause_3: Unlinked Duplication between Shared Store and uv Cache: vault/packages/python/shared and vault/packages/python/uv-cache stored independent physical copies without hardlink deduplication.
discrepancy_analysis_18gb.root_cause_4: Cargo Debug Build Artifacts: target/debug accumulated 4.76 GB of intermediate unoptimized objects.

architectural_improvements.cas_gc_hardlink_accounting: Fixed CAS GC to check link_count == 1 before reporting physical bytes reclaimed and record volume_free_bytes_delta
architectural_improvements.failed_reclamation_lifecycle: Added EnvironmentLifecycleState::FailedReclamation to prevent silently masking unlinked or lingering directories
architectural_improvements.pre_materialization_recovery: Implemented scan_and_reclaim_abandoned_environments() in ulvo-discovery to clean crashed runs and stale leases
architectural_improvements.cache_governance_cli: Implemented ulvo cache status, ulvo cache prune [--dry-run], and ulvo cache gc [--max-gb <GB>]
architectural_improvements.structured_run_execution: Added ulvo run --json returning RunExecutionResult with exit_code, duration_ms, cleanup_verdict, residual_environment_path, and physical_storage_delta_bytes
architectural_improvements.python_lazy_imports: Implemented __getattr__ lazy imports in Academic/sem5/DL/exp1/main.py reducing startup latency from >35s to 252ms
